name: Tuğçe Büyükuğurlu
bio: A child who always pursued books, stories and thoughts with curiosity, Tuğçe Ebesek Büyükuğurlu grew up and found a department that held all of these. Hidden in the Ancient Languages and Cultures corridors of Istanbul University, she spent years full of mythology, philosophy and mysterious languages that are no longer spoken. After graduating from Latin Language and Literature, she did not want to leave and did her master’s degree there. While thinking about how to share this magical journey with children, she came across Philosophy for Children. She founded Philotopia to meet more children and to bring teachers, who can reach even more children, into this adventure. She continues her journey, meeting more children and educators every day.
